tools.name: buttercms_list_posts
tools.description: List published blog posts, newest first, with optional filters by author, category or tag. Use exclude_body to get short results. Read API: GET /posts/.

tools.name: buttercms_get_post
tools.description: Get one blog post by slug, with the full body, metadata, and the next and previous posts. Read API: GET /posts/{slug}/.

tools.name: buttercms_search_posts
tools.description: Full-text search in blog post titles, bodies and summaries. Results are sorted by relevance. Read API: GET /posts/search/.

tools.name: buttercms_list_authors
tools.description: List all blog authors. Set include to 'recent_posts' to embed the recent posts of each one. Read API: GET /authors/.

tools.name: buttercms_get_author
tools.description: Get one blog author by slug. Set include to 'recent_posts' to embed the recent posts. Read API: GET /authors/{slug}/.

tools.name: buttercms_list_categories
tools.description: List all blog categories. Set include to 'recent_posts' to embed the recent posts of each one. Read API: GET /categories/.

tools.name: buttercms_get_category
tools.description: Get one blog category by slug. Set include to 'recent_posts' to embed the recent posts. Read API: GET /categories/{slug}/.

tools.name: buttercms_list_tags
tools.description: List all blog tags. Set include to 'recent_posts' to embed the recent posts of each one. Read API: GET /tags/.

tools.name: buttercms_get_tag
tools.description: Get one blog tag by slug. Set include to 'recent_posts' to embed the recent posts. Read API: GET /tags/{slug}/.

tools.name: buttercms_list_pages
tools.description: List pages of one page type, or all Single Pages with page_type '*'. Filtering and ordering work only for a real page type. Read API: GET /pages/{page_type}/.

tools.name: buttercms_get_page
tools.description: Get one page by page type and slug. Use '*' as page_type for a Single Page. Read API: GET /pages/{page_type}/{page_slug}/.

tools.name: buttercms_search_pages
tools.description: Search the direct content of pages by text. Results are sorted by relevance. Read API: GET /pages/search/.

tools.name: buttercms_get_collections
tools.description: Get the items of one or more collections at once. Every key must be an existing collection key. Read API: GET /content/?keys=a,b.

tools.name: buttercms_list_collection_items
tools.description: List the items of one collection, with paging, ordering and field filters. Each item meta.id is the item id. Read API: GET /content/{collection_key}/.

tools.name: buttercms_get_collection_item
tools.description: Get one collection item by its numeric id. Read API: GET /content/{collection_key}/{item_id}/.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: buttercms_list_posts, buttercms_get_post, buttercms_search_posts, buttercms_list_authors, buttercms_get_author, buttercms_list_categories, buttercms_get_category, buttercms_list_tags, buttercms_get_tag · Public sink: buttercms_get_post, buttercms_search_posts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: buttercms_list_posts, buttercms_get_post, buttercms_search_posts, buttercms_list_authors, buttercms_get_author, buttercms_list_categories, buttercms_get_category, buttercms_list_tags, buttercms_get_tag · Public sink: buttercms_get_post, buttercms_search_posts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
